opening.argument: The presentation promotes joining OneCoin mining as a way for investors to receive tokens and rewards, while urging timely participation when mining difficulty is reduced. It links holding the coins for at least a year with obtaining a real profit and describes storing, selling, or trading them as ways to profit. The speaker further projects that OneCoin could reach 2.5 to 5 euros per piece within a year. Taken together, the invitation to participate, the stated profit outcome from holding, and the future price projection present token acquisition as an opportunity for appreciation and returns.

citations.quote: If you join in time, you do it when the difficulty is reduced.
What's beneficial to do is to actually speculate the market, to store the coins for at least a year and so you will have a real profit.
we hope that in a year this will be between 2,5 to 5 euros per piece.
